topic: Dashboard filtering by facility working hours
summary_markdown:
A feature request was discussed to implement a default filter on the traffic dashboard. This filter must restrict data display to specified working hours for each facility.

**Requirements:**
*   Working hours must be sourced from inventory settings.
*   The working hour filter must be active by default when users view the dashboard.
*   Users need the ability to disable this filter using a toggle button.
decisions: Implement default working hours filtering on the traffic dashboard.
